verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only Dagster libraries that orchestrate third-party ingestion tools: Fivetran connectors, Airbyte syncs and dlt sources, shown as Dagster assets. The connectors themselves belong to those external tools. Nothing in the pack documents a broad Dagster-maintained catalog of SaaS API, database or file connectors, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I pick from a broad catalog of maintained connectors for the SaaS APIs, databases, and files my company actually uses
